A guide to handler pairs
This article is for visitors

Handler pairs at Aurelia Skyways

The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers prepare for flights with pets. Staff keep a simple record of service changes in the desk ledger so the cabin team can follow the latest notes during the trip. This helps support steady care from check-in to arrival.

When a traveler arrives with a companion animal, the desk reviews the booking details and confirms what has been arranged. The staff also share practical instructions with the crews so handling stays consistent. Clear notes are especially useful when a pet needs a different routine from the one first planned.

Travelers should keep documents ready and describe any changes as early as possible. If a pet has new feeding needs, a crate adjustment, or a revised handoff plan, the desk can update the record and pass the information along. Simple updates reduce confusion and help the cabin team stay prepared.

If you are traveling with a pet, follow the directions given by the desk and the crew throughout the journey. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure.
